title: CIA and ODNI reportedly discover breach exposing some unclassified information, NYT reports
date_note: The pages give only the publication day of the New York Times report; the intrusion date is not stated.
org: CIA / Office of the Director of National Intelligence
geo_basis: US federal agencies named in the source; Washington, D.C. used, no site stated
summary: According to the New York Times, citing people familiar with the matter, the CIA and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence recently discovered a breach that exposed some unclassified information. Reuters, relaying the report, says the intrusions hit a network used to analyze publicly available information, and other agencies may have been affected. ODNI told Reuters the breach did not disrupt critical capabilities or classified systems; the CIA had not responded. Fox News, citing multiple unnamed sources, says no classified system was affected and the problem has been resolved; Fox says it is unclear who was behind it.
plain: The New York Times, citing people familiar with the matter, reports a breach at the CIA and ODNI that exposed some unclassified information. ODNI told Reuters classified systems were not disrupted.
exec: A reported breach of a US intelligence analysis network exposed some unclassified information; what was taken is unclear, per the reports.
impact: What data was taken is unclear, according to the Reuters relay of the NYT report.

sources.name: WTVB (Reuters, relaying the New York Times)
Cedar News (Reuters, relaying the New York Times)

validation.note: Reuters (relayed by WTVB and Cedar News, one publisher) and Fox News, which cites its own unnamed sources besides the New York Times, each state the CIA/ODNI breach. ODNI's statement to Reuters acknowledges it. The NYT page could not be loaded.

review.note: title, scope, ODNI statement, CIA no response checked against both Reuters relays
